services.description: Valkey, the BSD-licensed Redis fork

runtime.start:
umask 077
acl="$STACK_DATA_DIR/users.acl"
if [ ! -e "$acl" ]; then
  printf 'user default on >%s ~* &* +@all\n' "$VALKEY_ADMIN_PASSWORD" > "$acl"
fi
exec "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/valkey-server" --port "$STACK_PORT" --bind 127.0.0.1 --dir "$STACK_DATA_DIR" --unixsocket "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR/valkey.sock" --appendonly no --aclfile "$acl"
runtime.provision:
set -eu
result="$(printf 'ACL SETUSER %s reset on >%s ~* &* +@all -@admin\nACL SAVE\n' "$STACK_GROUP" "$REDIS_PASSWORD" | VALKEYCLI_AUTH="$VALKEY_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/valkey-cli" -s "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR/valkey.sock" --no-auth-warning 2>&1)"
if [ "$result" != "$(printf 'OK\nOK')" ]; then
  printf 'Valkey refused the group account: %s\n' "$result" >&2
  exit 1
fi

services.description: MongoDB 8.0, the long-term release
MongoDB 8.3, the newest release
The MongoDB Shell, the current line
PostgreSQL 18, supported until November 2030

runtime.initialise:
set -e
if [ -e "$STACK_DATA_DIR/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'The existing PostgreSQL cluster uses an unsupported data layout; preserve it and choose an empty instance directory.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' "$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD" | "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/initdb" --pgdata="$STACK_DATA_DIR/pgdata" --username=stack_admin --auth=scram-sha-256 --pwfile=/dev/stdin --encoding=UTF8 --no-sync

windows.initialise:
set -e
if [ -e "$STACK_DATA_DIR/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'The existing PostgreSQL cluster uses an unsupported data layout; preserve it and choose an empty instance directory.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
password_file="$STACK_DATA_DIR/initdb-password"
trap 'rm -f "$password_file"' EXIT
printf '%s\n' "$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD" > "$password_file"
"$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/initdb.exe" --pgdata="$STACK_DATA_DIR/pgdata" --username=stack_admin --auth=scram-sha-256 --pwfile="$password_file" --encoding=UTF8 --locale=C --no-sync

Go 1.26, the previous release, supported until Go 1.28 ships
Node.js 24, the current long-term support release
Node.js 26, the current release, which is not long-term support
Node.js 20, past end of life; receives no security fixes
Node.js 18, past end of life: it receives no security fixes
Node.js 16, past end of life: it receives no security fixes
PHP 8.5, in active support until the end of 2027
PHP 8.4, in active support
PHP 8.3, security fixes until the end of 2027
PHP 8.2, security fixes only, and they end 31 December 2026
PHP 8.1, past end of life since December 2025
Python 3.14, taking bug fixes until October 2030
Ruby 3.3, security fixes only, and they end 31 March 2027
Ruby 3.4, in normal maintenance: it still takes bug fixes
Ruby 4.0, the current release
Rust 1.98, the current stable release
Rust 1.97, past end of life: Rust fixes only its newest stable release
NATS 2.15, the newest release
NATS 2.14, the previous release line
Composer 2, the current line
pnpm 11, the line pnpm points its own users at
pnpm 12, newer than the line pnpm recommends
versitygw, an S3 gateway over a plain directory

runtime.provision:
set -ef
export ADMIN_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$ROOT_ACCESS_KEY"
export ADMIN_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$ROOT_SECRET_KEY"
export ADMIN_ENDPOINT_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$STACK_PORT"

admin() {
  "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/versitygw" admin "$@"
}

for bucket in $STACK_BUCKETS; do
  admin list-buckets | awk '{print $1}' | grep -qx "$bucket" ||
    admin create-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --owner "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
done
